dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 妻子
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 李斌你再不出来，你那什么破玩具腰带，我马上给扔了。

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium close-up standoff composition with the wife standing at the guest-bedroom door and the husband sitting at a small desk in the bedroom with his back to her. The wife at the door is shown in three-quarter view, face and body tense. Rage expression at the brink — eyes wide open with the upper lid pulled back exposing a thin ring of white sclera, eyebrows drawn down and pinched inward at the bridge almost forming a V, mouth open mid-threat with the upper teeth visible, lips pulled back, slight flush on the cheeks, head thrust slightly forward. One hand extended pointing at the matte black plastic toy rider belt with silver-colored plastic buckle sitting on the desk beside the husband's right hand. Long straight black hair completely down, single pearl stud earring, small gold locket at neckline, fresh nude-pink gel manicure visible on the pointing hand. Fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top, light grey high-waisted yoga leggings. The husband at the desk has short black slightly messy side-swept hair and is wearing a loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt, his back to the wife, shoulders lifting slightly in response to the threat. Warm yellow-white bedroom light plus a single overhead ceiling light behind the camera casting the wife's shadow forward onto the husband. Mood: the marital confiscation, the wife threatening to throw away the only thing that made him smile today. Text watermark 'P14-PN08' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: cute anime anger marks like # # # cross veins on forehead, perfectly styled hair, tears, symmetrical cute anime proportions, smile of any kind, husband facing the wife (he is facing the desk), decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, romantic soft lighting
